This is a bounded software check, not a full-cohort benchmark, biological validation, clean installation test or cross-platform result. Thresholds and dimension caps still need study-specific justification.

This walkthrough follows quality-controlled, rRNA-depleted reads through per-sample profiling, table joining, normalization, and interpretation. It is a computational profile of transcript evidence, not a direct measurement of enzyme activity or metabolic flux.

For learners comfortable with basic shell navigation and FASTQ files who already have HUMAnN 3 and its databases configured; you will profile each prepared sample, join its pathway tables, and produce a CPM table.
